text:
irma-docs: opened a tiny PR to standardize audit-log retention phrasing and add a compact CLI example for migrations: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/912

leo-legal: quick legal note: avoid absolutes like 'permanent' or 'forever' in public docs. SOC2 reviewers want explicit scope + legal-hold exception.

hafsa-eng: also spotted the CLI snippet uses an older output shape. New CLI returns `retention_policy` and `pseudonymize` fields. I'll paste a minimal sample we can use.

omar-privacy: propose short public sentence: "Audit logs are retained according to customer-configured retention policies; Redwood does not retain logs beyond those settings except as required to comply with legal obligations (e.g., legal holds)."

hafsa-eng: sample CLI snippet for the doc (keeps JSON compact):
```
# rctl audit get --tenant org_99 --format json
{"tenant":"org_99","retention_policy":{"mode":"ttl","seconds":2592000},"pseudonymize":false}
```

ci-bot: PR #912  checks: unit-tests passed, link-checker: warning (internal link removed), lint passed

irma-docs: removed internal playbook link and updated the CLI/sample output and wording. tagging @leo-legal @omar-privacy for final ack, will merge after CI passes. thanks!
